steps.1: Heat-Heat oil or butter in a frying pan or skillet over medium-high heat
steps.2: Season-Season meat in a bowl or on a cutting board with salt and pepper
steps.3: Place-Place meat into the hot frying pan
steps.4: Cook-Cook and sear meat in the pan, stirring or flipping with a spatula or spoon
steps.5: Add-Add sauce or butter to the pan and baste with a spoon
steps.6: Check-Check internal meat temperature with food probe (target >= 74C / 165F)
steps.7: Plate-Transfer cooked meat onto a plate and serve
